freezeCriteria: Freeze named browser candidates after public access screening but before running any new nine-case guided packet; do not remove a frozen candidate after seeing refusals, quotas, paywalls, errors, or invalid outputs.
The PDF cohort is StillOpen, PDF24, zPDF, and PDF2Go on six damaged PDFs plus three healthy PDF controls.
The JPEG cohort is StillOpen and ToolTea on six damaged JPEGs plus three healthy JPEG controls.
The PNG cohort is StillOpen and ToolTea on six damaged PNGs plus three healthy PNG controls.
Report each format separately and never calculate an overall repair percentage across products with different format coverage.
Keep qpdf, MuPDF, Ghostscript, pngfix, and WhatsApp JPEG Image Repair in a separately labeled recovery-engine baseline layer.
Document desktop downloads, authentication failures, quotas, paywalls, unavailable services, and different recovery tasks in the exclusion appendix without inventing recovery scores.
objective: Qualify reproducible free browser-product competitors for PDF, JPEG, and PNG while preserving command-line engine baselines and the broader excluded-provider landscape.

corpus.groundTruthPolicy: The untouched public source is the comparison target; no provider receives the ground-truth source as an assisted-repair sample.
corpus.outputRequirement: A complete downloadable output is required for a verified pass. A frozen provider that fails to return one remains in its format cohort with the observed terminal outcome.

qualificationPolicy.directRepairDefinition: The operator supplies an already-available damaged file and the product attempts to return a repaired copy.
qualificationPolicy.deletedFileRecoveryDefinition: The product scans a disk, volume, partition, or image to locate deleted or lost files. It is a different task even when the recovered file is later opened.
qualificationPolicy.directRepairCohort: Only direct repair products are compared in the PDF, JPEG, and PNG cohorts.
qualificationPolicy.assistedRecoveryTrack: A same-device healthy sample may be supplied only in a separately labeled assisted run, never the benchmark ground truth.
qualificationPolicy.enhancementRule: Disable AI enhancement, upscaling, recoloring, denoising, and other appearance-changing modes.
qualificationPolicy.trialRule: A demo, placeholder, preview-only, watermarked, truncated, or paywalled result proves access behavior but is not a scoreable full output.
qualificationPolicy.consumerBrowserRule: Pre-run screening requires a plausible normal macOS browser path with no installation or advertised paid export. Once registered, the candidate remains in its nine-case format cohort even if actual execution reveals a quota, sign-in, payment, or output failure.
qualificationPolicy.engineBaselineRule: Command-line and build-from-source tools may be scored for recovery capability under the same validators but must be reported separately from consumer browser experience.
qualificationPolicy.independentValidation: Compare PDF page count, rendered pixels, and extracted text; compare JPEG/PNG dimensions and every decoded RGBA pixel. Self-reported success is not sufficient.
qualificationPolicy.cloudSafety: Use only the public holdout corpus; record sign-in, quota, retention, and deletion terms without recording credentials or personal email addresses.

rosterRoles.competitor: Legacy broad technical role for a direct-repair candidate; it does not by itself imply an equivalent consumer experience.
rosterRoles.consumer-browser-competitor: A no-install browser product with complete repeatable free output, eligible for the main product comparison after validation.
rosterRoles.engine-baseline: A command-line or build-from-source repair implementation comparable on recovery capability but not consumer workflow.
rosterRoles.access-excluded: A direct-repair product retained in market analysis but excluded by installation, platform, quota, authentication, availability, preview, or payment boundary.
rosterRoles.control: StillOpen's local implementation used to verify the protocol and corpus.
rosterRoles.adjacent-excluded: A deleted-file, disk, or media recovery product kept only to document the category boundary.
